skill.summary: 规范 AI 生成飞书技术文档结构，确保 Markdown 层级正确、章节顺序稳定、可读性高。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the frontend-tech-doc-guide skill.
- Defines strict rules for AI-generated Feishu technical documents, focusing on correct Markdown heading hierarchy and stable section order.
- Specifies structured templates for each document section, including use of lists, tables, and mandatory Mermaid diagrams.
- Enforces clear readability standards to avoid long continuous text blocks.
- Outlines detailed requirements for module breakdown, data tracking, and acceptance sections.
- Sets quality checks and output constraints to ensure high-quality, consistent documents.
